lines: Dictionary order is decided from left to right. Before RAHUL, count every valid arrangement formed by placing a smaller available letter at the first position where the word can differ.
Those earlier blocks contain {precedingCount} arrangements altogether, so RAHUL comes immediately after them.
NAAGI uses the same letters as AGAIN, including the two identical A's, so repeated arrangements must not be counted twice.
All distinct words beginning with A, G or I come before NAAGI; together those blocks contain {precedingCount} words.
Hence NAAGI is the {answer}th distinct arrangement in dictionary order.
